BK85XXB#

Control the B&K Precision 85xx electronic load from Python through InstroELoad.

The BK85XXB provides a driver that can be used to instantiate an InstroELoad.

Creating an InstroELoad with BK85XXB#

from instro.eload.drivers import BK85XXB
from instro.eload import InstroELoad

eload = InstroELoad(
    name="myELoad",
    driver=BK85XXB(visa_resource="USB0::0x0614::0x0960::8514B12345::INSTR"),
)

Parameters and methods specific to BK85XXB can be found in the SDK.
